create_benchmark_reducer_subclass: create a subclass of BenchmarkReducer that implements join_results, save_results, compute_metrics, save_metrics, and log_metrics abstract methods
run_json_df_reducer: run a JsonDFReducer to join JSON result files into a DataFrame and compute MAE metrics against target data
join_results_json_files: join multiple JSON result files from a directory into a single pandas DataFrame using glob pattern matching
compute_mae_metrics: compute mean absolute error metrics for common columns between prediction results and target data DataFrames
